title: AuthZEN Conformance Fixture
description: Evaluates the 8-decision AuthZEN Authorization API 1.0 certification fixture through the spec-mandated subject/action/resource/context request envelope, against a local hand-authored decision policy. AuthZEN is an OpenID Foundation open specification, not a regulation -- the policy VALUES are local test-fixture rules (the spec is explicit that PDP decision logic is out of scope), while the request/response shape and boolean-only Decision semantics they are expressed through are spec-cited (see the node's cited_clause_digest). Also checks the spec's context-is-OPTIONAL invariant on every decision: attaching a context object never changes the outcome.

requests.description: Optional override of the AuthZEN Access Evaluation requests to evaluate. Each item: { name, subject: {type,id,properties?}, action: {name,properties?}, resource: {type,id,properties?}, expected? }. Defaults to the canonical 8-decision certification fixture from AUTHZEN-CONFORMANCE-BUILD-SPEC.md when omitted.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_authzen_conformance_fixture
mcp_tool_definition.description: Evaluates the AuthZEN Authorization API 1.0 8-decision certification fixture (or a caller-supplied override) against a local decision policy, through the spec-mandated request/response envelope, and reports per-decision agreement with the mandated outcomes and the context-optional invariant.
